remarks: Beautifully renovated one-bedroom ranch style condo is move-in ready. Stepping inside you find an open layout filled with natural light where living and dining areas flow nicely into a stylish new galley kitchen with custom cabinets, white appliances and new tile floor. Spacious bedroom with great custom built closet and bathroom with tub and shower has been updated with a fresh modern look. Excellent closet space, recessed lighting, new laminate floor and the convenience of having washing and dryer in the unit. Enjoy your morning coffee on the balcony that really makes this unit feel large and open. Freshly painted. Parking space #1. This condo offers great access to everything that Stamford has to offer. Excellent credit and references required. MUST SEE!!
